fossilMin.taxon: Juramaia sinensis (BMNH PM1143), the oldest eutherian
fossilMin.formation: Daxigou site, Tiaojishan Formation, Liaoning, China
fossilMin.dating: Radiometrically constrained to just over 160 Ma (Oxfordian); top of the Oxfordian 157.3 ± 1.0 Ma gives 156.3 Ma
fossilMin.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 59 (Crown Theria)

softMax.basis: Allows for southern tribosphenic mammals such as Ambondro being therians: Bathonian, 168.3 ± 1.3 Ma
softMax.checked: Benton et al. 2015, full text (palaeo-electronica.org/content/pdfs/424.pdf), node 59 (Crown Theria)

clock.method: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock (MCMCTree), posterior mean and 95% HPD
